step1_analysis.description: A fully differential amplifier stage utilizing a cross-coupled NMOS pair (XM3, XM4) as an active negative-resistance load for the input pair (XM1, XM2). It provides moderate gain and high bandwidth, and is likely used as a pre-amplifier in the comparator of the delta-sigma modulator's quantizer.

paper_reference.title: Very Low-Voltage Digital-Audio Modulator with 88-dB Dynamic Range Using Local Switch Bootstrapping

dynamic_range.description: Dynamic range of the full delta-sigma modulator

sky130_expected.calculation: System-level metric, depends on oversampling ratio and noise shaping. Cannot be measured on this single sub-block.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assumed similar to paper if the full system was implemented.

peak_snr.description: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of the modulator

signal_bandwidth.description: Signal bandwidth of the audio modulator

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of this specific sub-block

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 PMOS parameters and provided VBIAS. Much lower than the 1mW reported for the entire modulator.

subblock_dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the amplifier stage

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1 / (gmb1 + gds1 + gds3). With gm1 ~ 487uS, gmb1 ~ 243uS, gds ~ 4uS, Gain ~ 1.97 V/V = 5.9 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cross-coupled load cancels the main transconductance (gm), leaving the body effect (gmb) and channel length modulation (gds) as the primary loads, resulting in low to moderate gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = G_out / (2*pi*C_out). G_out ~ 247uS, C_out ~ 20fF. BW ~ 2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low gain and small parasitic capacitance lead to very high bandwidth, typical for comparator pre-amplifiers.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, differential AC gain, bandwidth, and transient response of the cross-coupled differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Differential Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM4 OUT_PLUS OUT_MINUS VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 VBIAS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 OUT_MINUS OUT_PLUS VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N1 IN_MINUS OUT_PLUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N1 IN_PLUS OUT_MINUS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VGND GND 0 0
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.99

* Differential AC and Transient inputs
VIN_PLUS IN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0 0)
VIN_MINUS IN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0 180)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let vout_diff = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
  let vin_diff = v(IN_PLUS) - v(IN_MINUS)
  let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff / vin_diff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=10
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain_db - 3) fall=1
  
  tran 1n 5u
  let vout_diff_tran = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
  meas tran vout_max max vout_diff_tran
  meas tran vout_min min vout_diff_tran
  
  quit
.endc
.end
